# Björn Eberhardt – Leben

> Vector search engine and curated doc API for Björn Eberhardt's portfolio page.

## Public LLM Endpoint: /api/tiles

### Query Parameters with default values
- q="": Vector search query string (examples: 'contact', 'vision', 'sport', 'finance', '2025 piano concert')
- similar="": Alternative parameter for card similarity search (e.g. similar=finance returns cards semantically similar to 'finance')
- Omitting q and similar lists all cards in curated order
- offset=0: Number of cards to skip for pagination
- limit=20: Number of cards to return (set limit=0 to return all cards)
- lang=de: Language preference ('de' or 'en')
- detail=snippet: Output detail level
  - min: metadata (name, tags, type, score, date)
  - snippet: metadata + short summary cropped to 70 chars
  - summary: metadata + full high-level summary
  - full: metadata + full summary + full article body / HTML teaser / link
- format=json: Response format ('json' or 'toon'). Can also be set via HTTP header `Accept: text/x-toon`
- crop=0: Optional character count limit for summary/doc (default 70 when detail=snippet and crop=0)

### Single Tile Endpoints
- `GET /api/tiles/:name?lang=de`: Fetch details for a specific card by name
- `GET /api/tiles/:name/versions`: Fetch available language versions for a specific card

### Card Reference Types
- doc(size): HTML partial on server
- link: external URL

### Similarity Score
- 1.00: Exact semantic match
- 0.80 - 0.99: High relevance

### Example API Queries
- Vector Search: `/api/tiles?q=finance+investments&limit=3&lang=de`
- Similarity Search by Card: `/api/tiles?similar=finance&limit=3&lang=de`
- Explore All Cards: `/api/tiles?limit=0&detail=min&lang=en`
- Full document: `/api/tiles?q=vision&limit=1&detail=full&crop=4000&lang=en`
- TOON Text Format: `/api/tiles?q=vision&format=toon`

---
